hst.family: HST contact spheres, scaled with Spitzer MIPS
hst.axes: X joins the two centres; Z is perpendicular to X and follows the model pole. Body meridian is arbitrary.
hst.qualification: Inferred smooth shape. No resolved topography. The origin assumes equal lobe densities and is not a measured centre of mass.

radar.axisOrder: X along long axes, Z spin
radar.poleSource: Groussin et al. 2019, not a unique pole measured in the 2010 radar paper
radar.disposition: Retained as an alternative in the comparison; not combined with the HST model.
